title: NetworkSetupGrantSave
description: network.setup-grant-save@1 (capability network.setup.grant.save): the value(s) a person's own agent read from a provider's page, saved into exactly the one Setup row a one-time grant names (plan §AB.44). POST /internal/setup/grants/:id/save on OpenVibe.Network, with the agent's service token and the live grant: each key must be one of the grant's own; the grant is burnt by the first save; nothing is ever read back.

run.description: The agent run that read the value(s), for the audit line.
